Pinmode: Which points are fixed. top: points near the highest Y. attribute: points whose Pin attribute is above 0.5. group: points in the group named Pingroup. none: nothing pinned, cloth falls.
Pingroup: Name of the point group to pin when Pinmode is group.
Pinthickness: Height band below the topmost point, in world units, that gets pinned in top mode.
Wind: Wind strength along Winddir. 0 = no wind.
Winddir: Wind direction vector (X, Y, Z). It is normalised internally.
Turbulence: Amount of noise that varies the wind over space and time.
Damping: Velocity loss per step. 0 = none, higher settles faster.
Stiffness: Strength of the edge length constraints (0-1). Lower = stretchier cloth.
Iterations: Constraint relaxation passes per frame (max 128). More = less stretch but slower; dense meshes need more.
Spherepos: Centre of the collider sphere in world units.
Sphereradius: Radius of the collider sphere in world units.
Speed: Simulation time step scale. Keep at or below about 1.5 for stability.
Modgain: Scales the in2 modulation CHOP effect on wind, turbulence and gravity. 0 = ignore.
Play: On: the simulation advances. Off: it freezes.
Reset: Pulse: re-initialise the cloth from the current input mesh.
Maxneighbors: Size of the per-point neighbour array. Raise above the highest vertex valence of your mesh (grids need 6).
Demogrid: Grid resolution (N x N points) of the demo cloth when in1 is unconnected.
Demosize: Side length of the demo cloth in world units.
Color1: First checker colour of the preview cloth.
Color2: Second checker colour of the preview cloth.
Checker: Number of checker cells across the preview cloth.
Spherecolor: Colour of the collider sphere in the preview.
Camangle: Preview camera orbit angle in degrees.
Camdist: Preview camera distance in world units.
Camheight: Preview camera height in world units.
